entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A proud minotaur warrior from Talruum and the first mate aboard the skyship Weatherlight; mutated by Phyrexians.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship captained by Sisay, absorbed when the Legacy was completed.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight, a member of Urza's Bloodline project, who seeks the Legacy to kill the Lord of the Wastes.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Crewman of the Weatherlight who quit after Rofellos was killed, then rejoined and led the ship temporarily.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A cowardly, impulsive goblin crewman that Tahngarth detested.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem taken by the attackers on Rath and who helped complete the Legacy.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: Commander of the Predator who overpowered Tahngarth and was later killed by him.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Phyrexian under whose hands Tahngarth suffered; later disguised as a crew member and commanded the Recreant.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian leader who attacked the Weatherlight with tentacles and was destroyed by the completed Legacy.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker whose Bloodline project created defenders; helped complete the Legacy.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Weatherlight's navigator who acted as counselor and approached Tahngarth about his mutation.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: Crew member found alive and flourishing among the Cho-Arrim.

entities.name: Meida
entities.description: First mate killed in a fight in the Adarkar Wastes.

entities.name: Ghentoth
entities.description: Minotaur whom Tahngarth defeated as Sisay's champion.

entities.name: Rofellos
entities.description: Gerrard's friend, killed in the attack on Crovax's Estate.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who phased Zhalfir out of the time stream.

entities.name: Talruum
entities.description: Homeland of Tahngarth's minotaur clan.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane to which Sisay was abducted and the Weatherlight planeshifted.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: Plane where the Weatherlight crash-landed after Rath.

entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: Rebels who stole the Weatherlight believing it to be Ramos come again.

entities.name: Hurloon Minotaurs
entities.description: Minotaurs the Phyrexians planned to mutate; they accepted Tahngarth as their champion.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: Flying ship that attacked the Weatherlight on Rath.

entities.name: Recreant
entities.description: Volrath's ship, destroyed by the Weatherlight.

entities.name: The Legacy
entities.description: Items that merge into a powerful weapon, completed to destroy Yawgmoth.

entities.name: The Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of Dominaria by Yawgmoth's Phyrexians.

entities.name: Victory
entities.description: New ship given to Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee after the invasion.

events.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands in the Talruum Mountains; Tahngarth fights as Sisay's champion, defeats Ghentoth and joins her crew.
events.quote: Tahngarth offered to fight as Sisay's champion and proved himself by defeating Ghentoth.

events.summary: After Meida is killed in the Adarkar Wastes, Tahngarth becomes Sisay's first mate.
events.quote: he took her place as Sisay's first mate

events.summary: Gerrard quits the crew after Rofellos is killed at Crovax's Estate, confirming Tahngarth's suspicion.
events.quote: especially when the man quit the Weatherlight crew after the attack on Crovax's Estate

events.summary: Tahngarth convinces Gerrard to rejoin the crew after Sisay is taken to Rath.
events.quote: Tahngarth convinced Gerrard to rejoin the crew to help his friends

events.summary: On Rath the Predator attacks; Karn and the Legacy treasury are taken, and Tahngarth jumps to save Karn but is overpowered and captured by Greven il-Vec.
events.quote: he was overpowered by Greven il -Vec and captured as well

events.summary: Tahngarth is mutated by the Phyrexians under Volrath, then freed before the process completes; he helps free Sisay and the crew escapes to Mercadia.
events.quote: Tahngarth had been mutated by the Phyrexians

events.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands on Mercadia and the Cho-Arrim steal the ship.
events.quote: he could not prevent the rebels from stealing the ship

events.summary: Tahngarth tells Hanna he feels himself a monster and sees his mutation as punishment for his vanity.
events.quote: he admitted that he felt himself a monster now

events.summary: The crew finds Orim alive among the Cho-Arrim and learns of the myths of Ramos.
events.quote: they found Orim alive and flourishing

events.summary: Volrath, disguised as a crew member, is revealed to have orchestrated events; the crew escapes aboard the Weatherlight and destroys the Recreant, bringing peace to Mercadia.
events.quote: Blasting the bigger ship apart, the crew of the Weatherlight ensured a new era of peace on Mercadia

events.summary: The Weatherlight destroys the Phyrexian mutation plants among the Hurloon, and survivors accept Tahngarth as their champion.
events.quote: the Hurloon survivors all bowed down before Tahngarth and accepted him as their champion

events.summary: Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec in a rematch between Weatherlight and Predator.
events.quote: cleaving the commander's head in two

events.summary: Tahngarth hacks at Yawgmoth's tentacles, buying time for Gerrard, Urza and Karn to complete the Legacy and destroy Yawgmoth.
events.quote: This brave defiance bought Gerrard, Urza, and Karn enough time to complete the Legacy and destroy Yawgmoth.

events.summary: The Weatherlight is absorbed in the completed Legacy; Dominarians grant Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee a new ship, Victory.

relations.quote: the first mate aboard the skyship Weatherlight
He especially detested the goblin Squee
He took revenge upon Greven il-Vec in a rematch between Weatherlight and Predator
he and Tahngarth came to an understanding and began to respect one another
He joined her crew and quickly proved himself.
